report.explanation: Alert observations show all 200s with durations mostly 47-125ms and one 297ms outlier; traces show successful checkout with sub-100ms spans and no errors. Metrics show /v1/checkout p95 ~412ms but zero 502s. No evidence establishes a fault; healthy telemetry contradicts a fault hypothesis. Logs were excluded and downstream latency metrics absent, so a bounded cause cannot be substantiated. Handing off for more evidence.
